text: Does the shared-ancestor mechanism imply $C(r) \sim r^{-\alpha}$, and what is $\alpha$ on the committed knit?
description:
OP-11: measure the correlation exponent.

Known: interior distance grows like the logarithm of boundary distance (R-HLG-0002).

Unknown: $\alpha$, and whether any correlation is measured at all.

Why it matters: turns candidate PC-01 into a quantitative prediction, the first route to a row.

Scope: a small computational investigation.

Skills: hyperbolic geometry, statistical mechanics, numerical simulation.

Where to start: test/experiment/holography/bulk-shortcut-reachability.ts; Swingle 2012, Entanglement renormalization and holography.

The claims it would move: R-HLG-0002.

Evidence named: E-HLG-0004, E-HLG-0033.
